options.name: base_dn
options.description: LDAP base distinguished name string. required if C(idp_type) is set to I(ldap).

options.name: bind_dn
options.description: LDAP bind distinguished name string. Can be empty for anonymous binding.

options.name: bind_password
options.description: LDAP bind password. Can be empty for anonymous binding.

options.name: description
options.description: User directory description.

options.name: encrypt_assertions
options.description: SAML encrypt assertions. Encrypts if I(true). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: encrypt_nameid
options.description: SAML encrypt name ID. Encrypts if I(true). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: group_basedn
options.description: LDAP groups path in LDAP tree to search for groups data. Used to configure user membership check in I(openLDAP). Required if group_membership is not set. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: group_filter
options.description: LDAP search filter to select groups when searching for specific user groups. Used to configure user membership check in openLDAP. Ignored when provisioning a user if group_membership is set. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: group_member
options.description: LDAP tree attribute name containing group name received with C(group_filter) query. Used to configure user membership check in openLDAP. Ignored when provisioning a user if group_membership is set. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: group_membership
options.description: LDAP property containing groups of user. E.g. I(memberOf) This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: group_name
options.description: LDAP/SAML attribute name to get group name for group mapping between Zabbix and IdP. Used to configure user membership check in LDAP. Ignored when provisioning a user if group_membership is set. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: host
options.description: LDAP server host name, IP or URI. URI should contain schema, host and port (optional). required if C(idp_type) is set to I(ldap).

options.name: http_login_password
options.description: Basic Auth password

options.name: http_login_user
options.description: Basic Auth login

options.name: idp_entityid
options.description: SAML URI that identifies the IdP in SAML messages. required if C(idp_type) is set to I(saml). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: idp_type
options.description: Type of IdP. Only one user directory of type SAML can exist. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: name
options.description: Unique name of the user directory.

options.name: nameid_format
options.description: SAML SP name ID format. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: port
options.description: LDAP server port. required if C(idp_type) is set to I(ldap).

options.name: provision_groups
options.description: Array of the IdP media type mappings objects. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: provision_media
options.description: Array of the IdP media type mappings objects. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: provision_status
options.description: User directory provisioning status. if I(false) Provisioning of users created by this user directory is disabled if I(true) Provisioning of users created by this user directory is enabled. Additionally, the authentication status of C(ldap_jit_status) or C(saml_jit_status) should be enabled. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: scim_status
options.description: Whether the SCIM provisioning for SAML is enabled or disabled. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: search_attribute
options.description: LDAP attribute name to identify user by username in Zabbix database. required if C(idp_type) is set to I(ldap).

options.name: search_filter
options.description: LDAP custom filter string when authenticating user in LDAP. Supported search_filter placeholders I(%{attr}) search attribute name (uid, sAMAccountName); I(%{user}) username value.

options.name: sign_assertions
options.description: SAML sign assertions. Signs if I(true). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: sign_authn_requests
options.description: SAML sign AuthN requests. Signs if I(true). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: sign_logout_requests
options.description: SAML sign logout requests. Signs if I(true). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: sign_logout_responses
options.description: SAML sign logout responses. Signs if I(true). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: sign_messages
options.description: SAML sign messages. Signs if I(true). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: slo_url
options.description: SAML IdP service endpoint URL to which Zabbix will send SAML logout requests. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: sp_entityid
options.description: SAML SP entity ID. required if C(idp_type) is set to I(saml). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: sso_url
options.description: SAML URL of the IdP"s SAML SSO service, to which Zabbix will send SAML authentication requests. required if C(idp_type) is set to I(saml). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: start_tls
options.description: LDAP startTLS option. It cannot be used with ldaps:// protocol hosts.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the user directory. On C(present), it will create if user directory does not exist or update it if the associated data is different. On C(absent) will remove the user directory if it exists.

options.name: user_lastname
options.description: LDAP/SAML attribute name to use for users.surname field when user is provisioned This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: user_ref_attr
options.description: LDAP user object attribute name. Will be set instead of the placeholder I(%{ref}) in c(group_filter) string. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: user_username
options.description: LDAP/SAML attribute name to use for users.name field when user is provisioned This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: username_attribute
options.description: SAML username attribute to be used in comparison with Zabbix user.username value when authenticating. required if C(idp_type) is set to I(saml). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.
